messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: Critical observability gap detected for tenant 'solara-prod' in Dedicated Pool dp-57. Missing traces and log ingestion starting ~2026-03-15T00:12Z. Paging: @maria @josh

maria: on it. is this traces-only or logs too?

josh: both. logs show up in S3 but not in our indexing cluster, traces missing from trace-index. no customer-facing latency impact reported yet. :eyes:

kevin: pulling forwarder logs for dp-57 now. preliminary: forwarder auth failures.

kevin: ```
2026-03-15T00:12:04Z forwarder dp-57 ERROR Failed POST /ingest 403 AccessDenied RoleSessionExpired
2026-03-15T00:12:05Z forwarder dp-57 WARN Buffering 12000 events
2026-03-15T00:12:06Z forwarder dp-57 ERROR Auth refresh failed: module kms-client timeout
```

maria: looks like role rotation / KMS token refresh failure. @josh can you confirm if the role rotation job ran at ~00:10?

josh: yes rotation job executed at 00:10, but logs show an error contacting KMS in the same window. likely expired session for the forwarder.

anita: looping in AM/account. Solara (acct exec) is awake. I'll draft the note: short impact + mitigation + timeline. Anything to add now?

maria: mitigation plan: 1) spin a short-lived obs-proxy bridge with a cached role 2) restart dp-57 forwarder to pick up creds 3) kick an s3->ingest replay for 00:10-00:55 window 4) monitor trace-index for reappearances. executing step 1.

josh: executing temp bridge: `./scripts/obs-temp-bridge --pool dp-57 --ttl 1h` — output: Bridge created id=br-923, endpoint=https://br-923.obs.internal

kevin: updating forwarder config to point at bridge and restarting: `systemctl restart forwarder-dp-57` — restart successful.

obs-bot: healthcheck: br-923 forwarding to ingest: ok

maria: running replay job: `./tools/s3-replay --tenant solara-prod --from 2026-03-15T00:10Z --to 2026-03-15T00:55Z` — started.

josh: quick sanity: `curl -s "https://obs.internal/api/tenants/solara-prod/traces?since=2026-03-15T00:00Z" | jq 'length'` now returns >0 (traces reappearing)

kevin: forwarder metrics show throughput back to normal. buffer drain rate ~5k/s. replay queued chunks are being consumed.

anita: drafted message to Solara: "We're seeing a temporary observability ingestion gap (logs/traces) from 00:12–00:54 UTC due to rotated role failing to refresh. We have applied a temporary bridge and started replay; we'll follow up with a full postmortem and mitigation plan. Will offer credit — pls confirm tone." send when I get signoff from SRE.

maria: +1 from SRE. no evidence of data exfil or PII access. audit logs show auth failures not successes.

lucy: opening a customer-facing ticket INF-1234 and noting that metrics (latency/throughput) were not impacted, only observability ingest. attaching replay ETA.

obs-bot: Incident annotated: INF-1234 created; postmortem placeholder created at docs/incidents/INF-1234

josh: timeline note: root cause = expired role/session after rotation + transient KMS timeout. mitigation = temp bridge + forwarder restart + replay. long-term fix: add retries to role refresh and add canary that exercises forwarder after rotation.

maria: will own postmortem and follow-up action items. assigning: SRE to add canary (#A1), infra to harden KMS retries (#A2), account will send customer update (#A3). Thanks all.

anita: sending the note to Solara now. keeping channel open for final confirmation.

maria: closing thread after replay completes and buffer drained. last update will be the replay completion time and final incident severity.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved (monitoring).
